description: Unit test class for {@link ThingPredicateVisitor} that verifies filtering predicates on {@link Thing} objects using various criteria. Contains multiple test methods for different filter types and conditions.

classes.name: ThingPredicateVisitorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the predicate filtering logic applied on Thing objects.

methods.name: createCriteria
methods.description: Creates a filter criteria from a string filter expression using the query filter factory.

methods.name: createPredicate
methods.description: Creates a predicate for Thing objects based on a filter string.

methods.name: testPredicate
methods.description: Helper method that tests whether the predicate correctly filters matching and non-matching Thing objects, with support for escaping string values.

methods.name: testPredicateNeg
methods.description: Helper method to test the negation case where predicate is expected to evaluate to false for matching objects.
